about: What the dashboard knows about this install that it cannot read from the VM: names, who uses what, where secrets live, ports. Agents are named by their Hermes profile (default = the chief); the bridge turns profiles into the names in hermes.json. Anything on the VM that is not described here still shows up (as 'found, not described yet'). Items with a 'feature' are optional add-ons: they show as off until hermes.json switches that feature on.

integrations.name: DeepSeek
integrations.fix: top up at platform.deepseek.com, or paste a new key on the server with: sudo hermes-key deepseek
integrations.note: the agents' model (deepseek-flash), pay as you go

integrations.name: Gemini
integrations.note: used only when DeepSeek is down, and as a model choice for the dashboard's own AI jobs

integrations.name: Telegram
integrations.kind: bot tokens, one per agent (four bots)
integrations.fix: a new token from @BotFather, typed into that agent's .env, then a quiet restart

integrations.name: Mem0 (memory)
integrations.fix: sudo systemctl status mem0-server on the VM

integrations.name: OpenAlex
integrations.fix: hermes -p tutor plugins install openalex on the VM

integrations.name: Gmail
integrations.fix: a new app password at myaccount.google.com/apppasswords, typed in on the server with: sudo hermes-addon gmail
integrations.enable: switch it on, on the server, with: sudo hermes-addon gmail

integrations.name: Moodle
integrations.fix: copy a fresh MoodleSession cookie from your browser and type it in on the server with: sudo hermes-addon moodle
integrations.enable: switch it on, on the server, with: sudo hermes-addon moodle

integrations.name: University sign-in (renews Moodle)
integrations.secret: /var/lib/uni-login/private/creds.json (only the unilogin user can read it; no agent can)
integrations.fix: type the password and authenticator secret again on the server with: sudo uni-login setup (docs/UNI-LOGIN.md)
integrations.enable: set it up on the server with: sudo hermes-addon moodle-login

integrations.name: ElevenLabs (voice replies)
integrations.fix: a new key at elevenlabs.io, typed in on the server with: sudo hermes-key elevenlabs
integrations.enable: switch it on, on the server, with: sudo hermes-voice

integrations.name: Google Drive (backups)
integrations.fix: sign rclone in again: see docs/BACKUPS.md, then run on the server: sudo hermes-addon backup
integrations.enable: switch it on, on the server, with: sudo hermes-addon backup (docs/BACKUPS.md)

integrations.name: Gemini (content studio)
integrations.secret: the Clip Curator's .env (STUDIO_GEMINI_KEY, a copy of the Gemini key)
integrations.fix: change the key with: sudo hermes-key gemini, then re-copy it with: sudo hermes-addon studio
integrations.enable: switch it on, on the server, with: sudo hermes-addon studio
integrations.note: each new clip is watched once by Gemini Flash (about a cent)

tools.label: Board
tools.rule: the chief creates and hands out cards

tools.label: Gmail (add-on)
tools.rule: read and draft; never sends without your yes

tools.label: iCloud calendar (add-on)
tools.rule: the tutor reads; the assistant writes

mcp.moodle: one session cookie; renew it when it expires

roles.contentdirector: Plans the posts and pairs clips, lines and sounds
roles.clipcurator: Watches each new clip once and tags it
roles.overlaycopywriter: Writes overlay lines for you to approve

teams.label: Specialists
teams.note: one specialist each; the chief hands them cards

teams.label: Content studio
teams.note: a department of board workers for a video page: the Content Director leads; they prepare posts and you approve each one

timers.label: Nightly backup to Google Drive, encrypted (backup add-on)

suggestions.name: Wolfram|Alpha
suggestions.why: the tutor can check maths, physics and stats working step by step

suggestions.name: Strava
suggestions.why: the coach sees your runs, rides and training load (read only)

suggestions.name: AllTrails
suggestions.why: the coach can plan weekend walks and hikes near you

suggestions.name: Kiwi.com flights
suggestions.why: the assistant finds cheap flights and links you to book yourself

suggestions.name: Todoist
suggestions.why: if you keep a to-do list there, the assistant can read and add tasks

suggestions.name: Indeed
suggestions.why: the assistant can look for part-time jobs and internships
